en: I only came to see what this place is like.
Hello, Mr. Norman.
Do you remember meeting me before?
I know a great many people.
I can't remember every nobody I meet.
I suppose I'll at least hear you out.

en: I have more free time than you'd think.
Hello? May I come in?
If you want to come to my house, then come.
I won't stop you anymore.
But London's most important people often
visit this house, too.
Think carefully about what that means.
, you alone are my master.
Command me in anything you wish...
Too little exercise can make you ache, too.
Such a nuisance. Ah, ow, ow, ow...
For the glory of my master...
I often dream of roaming the streets at night.
Some sign from my unconscious, perhaps...
Who are you, sir?
Is there something you want of me?
We have not met before.
I was told this is Mr. Isaac's house.
So it is.
I am Isaac. My calling is to study ideas
and to look within myself.
Admirable work, that.
Work? That's not quite it.
Thought and labor are separate things.
What I do each day is
productive activity of the mind, you see.
I see... Interesting...
I shall drop by from time to time.
You seem an intelligent person. Very well.
You're welcome, as long as you don't disturb my thinking.
We've met before, haven't we?
Have you come to hear me speak?
I've taken an interest in thinkers.
I see. Well, to each their own, but
studying ideas and looking within myself is
what I consider my mission.
Thought and labor are different things.
What I do each day is productive activity of the mind,
you see.
Do come again.
I hear you've come from abroad.
You're something of a rumor around town.
Oh, no, not that I have any interest in
vulgar gossip, mind you...
Still, some things do reach one's ears.
True, I am not from this city, but
I have been to this country before.
Much has changed since those days,
it seems.
Welcome. Come, come in.
To meet an intelligent person such as you
is a great pleasure. You are most welcome.
As you see, I rarely even go outside.
So I know little of the world out there.
Nor do I make much effort to learn, but...
There are times when I want to hear
something interesting.
I plan to write a book that sets out
my thought. I'd be glad if it gave the people
of London some spiritual support...
We are human because we think,
I believe. Working is not enough.
Oh, and who might you be?
Indeed, so it is.
I am Isaac.
Are you interested in ideas?
Unfortunately, this is my private time.
Please come at another time.
So you've come again.
But at this hour I'm afraid I have no time
to talk. My apologies.
I'm only human, so I need time for meals
and for rest, you see.
